name: blood-moon-urborg-c3
about: Layer 4 (CR 613.7, 613.7e, 613.8): Urborg, Blood Moon, then Evil Presence attached to Urborg. The later Evil Presence wins (Urborg a Swamp); Urborg's own effect depends on both and never applies, so the Island isn't a Swamp. The basic Swamp only pays for Evil Presence.
